title: SM ST1C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine ST1C static excitation system with an automatic voltage regulator, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator output gain, K_A (pu)} sets the regulator gain, {Regulator output time constant, T_A (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B (s)} sets the regulator lag time constant for first lead-lag, {Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant for first lead-lag, {Regulator denominator (lag) time constant, T_B 1(s)} sets the regulator lag time constant for second lead-lag, {Regulator numerator (lead) time constant, T_C1 (s)} sets the regulator lead time constant for second lead-lag, {Rate feedback gain, K_F (pu)}, {Rate feedback time constant, T_F (s)}, {Maximum regulator output, V_Amax (pu)} sets the upper limit of the regolator output, {Minimum regulator output, V_Amin (pu)} sets the lower limit of the regolator output, {Maximum voltage error (regulator input), V_Imax (pu)} sets the voltage upper limit, {Minimum voltage error (regulator input), V_Imin (pu)} sets the voltage lower limit, {Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} sets the pSS input location Summation point at voltage, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Exciter output current limiter gain, K_LR (pu)}, {Exciter output current limit reference, I_LR (pu)}, {Maximum exciter output, V_Rmax (pu)} sets the exciter upper limit and {Minimum exciter output, V_Rmin (pu)} sets the exciter lower limit. Values come from the instance.
